content.rendered:
Congratulations, you’re a citrus fruit now! 

 

 

Aries: Blood orange. Fiery at first glance but sweet at heart. 

 

Taurus: A classic lime, always bringing a bright taste to the table. 

 

Gemini: A pomelo, because you never go unnoticed. 

 

Cancer: Yuzu. You’re the dreamy one. 

 

Leo: The citrus king — orange. It just makes sense for you.

 

Virgo: Tanglo. Silly and fun! 

 

Libra: White grapefruit, the refined choice. 

 

Scorpio: And you’re the ruby red grapefruit. More intense, but a staple for sure.

 

Sagittarius: Nothing less than a lemon for you. So versatile. 

 

Capricorn: Key lime and sweet as pie. 

 

Aquarius: Obviously a clementine, the cutest option. 

 

Pisces: Tangerine. You’re a different kind of sweet.

content.rendered:
Capricorn: This spring break, you will reconnect with your inner self. Take time to relax and enjoy the space to think.

 

Aquarius: This spring break will bring lots of good food and fun times with friends and family.

 

Pisces: This spring break comes with much-deserved rest. Sleep lots and recharge your mind and spirit. 

 

Aries: Enjoy the fresh air this spring break — get outside and connect with the natural world.

 

Taurus: This spring break will allow you to clear your mind and make decisions about questions that have been stressing you out.

 

Gemini: Relax this spring break with your favorite pastimes, shows, movies, and books; indulge in things that school has prevented you from enjoying. 

 

Cancer: Spring break will come with a chance to reconnect with your friends and family. Spend time with them and plan fun activities.

 

Leo: This spring break, you will have lots of fun exploring and trying new things. This could be on a trip or at home doing or making something new.

 

Virgo: Take time to meditate and reflect on your mental wellness this spring break — read books, put social media away, and try to quiet your mind.

 

Libra: This spring break will give you a chance to explore new ways to relax and will allow you to recharge before coming back to finish the semester.

 

Scorpio: This spring break will be filled with warmth, laughter, and love. Stop worrying about the future and enjoy the present. 

 

Sagittarius: Spring break will allow you to rest and recharge after a busy few weeks of school. Take time to relax and take care of yourself.

content.rendered:
Gemini: Treat yourself. You deserve it. 

Cancer: Create a photo collage of all the things you love.

Leo: Spread your radiance. Be a dazzle of light!

Virgo: Enjoy the moment — let all the negative things go.

Libra: Brace all the good things by having an open heart. 

Scorpio: Stay up late and hang out with your favorite person.

Sagittarius: Shoot for the hearts, even if you miss a couple. (Go to them!)

Capricorn: Get that Capri-Sun. Leave your goddamn room, see the sun, and socialize. 

Aquarius: Water your plants — they need a little love.

Pisces: Put your artistic cap on and create a lovely letter for your favorite person.

Aries: Be bold! Pour your heart out.

Taurus: Venture around to the unknown, maybe there is a fairy around.

content.rendered:
My bitter yellow comes with me on walks.

It’s a shadow of a past that refuses to talk.

A room in Oklahoma filled with quilted flowers,

A closet with dolls and childhood trousers.

 

My bitter yellow is all that I want — A craving,

A joy. A feeling of distraught.

It’s the corduroy couches that pass the hour,

A dated television that slowly devours.

 

You don’t know my bitter yellow —

The aches. The pains. The homemade Jell-O.

My memories of citrus always seem to sour,

My tainted southern vowels created a coward.

 

My bitter yellow starts with divorce:

A couple that carries lifetime remorse.

It’s a sailor dress that I wore for hours,

A spoonful of honey, I wish to devour.

 

It’s a continuous trip of graveyard endeavors.

A terrible feeling that drifts on forever.

My personalized soliloquy, an orchestrated cello

A room in Oklahoma stained bitter yellow.

content.rendered:
sun pitching into the lake

its light stringing cobwebs 

among the pines when we arrive,

leash coiled in hand. 

 

                            my dog’s world, typically confined to a linden tree and

                            raised garden within a parched, patchwork lawn,

                            now unfolds like roses bursting their velvet seams.

 

there is still in his old body

a gluttonous desire for adventure—

that longing, that curiosity

that lords over him,

 

                            that resides mostly in his nose;

                            his nose which tempts him down

                            toward the amber soaked shore—

 

releasing a sudden thunder of mallards’ wings

and raucous honking of perturbed ducks

startled by my ecstatic lab,

 

                          startling the lab back to me for reassurances 

                          I offer, basking in the familiarity of pats,

                          tail warming to a steady wag again,

                          now plodding with renewed confidence underfoot.

 

paws plummeting down his dirt-path highway,

with one defiant glance his brown eyes

beckon you to join him:

 

                       mouth gaping, tongue fluttering

                       gorging on the fearsome, full pleasures

                       of this earth.

content.rendered:
You hadn’t planned to stay but the cold
and my comforter helped you uncover

the shape of freckles
underneath my foundation, and the feeling

of my fingers tracing the outline
of infinity along your spine, and a smile

graces my face before I realize your eyelashes
flutter at the same pace as my stomach

excerpt.rendered: Forest Eyes   Her iris smells of morning rain, Of decomposing leaves in soil. Her gaze grows mushrooms in my brain, And grapevines cross my flesh like coil.   We sit beside a waterfall. My roots plant firmly in the rock So that I cannot move at all. I only listen to Her talk.  …

content.rendered:
1. Forest Eyes

 

Her iris smells of morning rain,

Of decomposing leaves in soil.

Her gaze grows mushrooms in my brain,

And grapevines cross my flesh like coil.

 

We sit beside a waterfall.

My roots plant firmly in the rock

So that I cannot move at all.

I only listen to Her talk.

 

Her voice sounds sweet like chirping birds

A song to mesmerize my heart,

I cherish every given word

And feel the sounds tear me apart.

 

Within Her eyes, a forest thrives.

Admiring them, I feel alive.

 

  1. Forest Woman

 

As the night approaches,

And the wind grows cold.

As the sound of the stream

Carves through the trees,

And the animals come for me.

 

I caress Your hair like moss.

I hold You close to me

And smell the wildflowers

That grow from within You.

 

I kiss the bark of the trees,

I lay on the smooth stones,

I open myself up to the forest,

And I want You to consume me.

 

Yet, You never do,

But I don’t mind.

I release my heart into Your winds,

And I cherish the whisper in return.

 

  1. Forest Fire

 

I would do anything to kiss you just once.

 

To feel the fire singe my lips

       And spread across my cheeks as you hold them.

To feel your perfume like smoke tickle my nose.

To feel the flames of your hair tangle with mine

       And intertwine like branches in a forest fire.

To feel my body grow hot as you step close

       And as your weight presses against me

       Our skin melts into molten passion.

To feel innocent in the chaos.

To feel the fire cleanse us of worry and doubt.

To feel like everything will burn down around us.

 

And even if we never kiss again,

At least my heart will have been consumed by our fire.
